props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the switch is currently active.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Whether the switch is initially active.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: form
props.description: Identifies the form that owns the hidden input. Useful when the switch is rendered outside the form.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the hidden input element.

props.name: inputRef
props.type: ((instance: HTMLInputElement | null) => void | (() => void | { [UNDEFINED_VOID_ONLY]: never; }) | DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES[keyof DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES]) | RefObject<HTMLInputElement | null>
props.description: A ref to access the hidden `<input>` element.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `true` if the rendered element is a native button.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Event handler called when the switch is activated or deactivated.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the user should be unable to activate or deactivate the switch.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the user must activate the switch before submitting a form.

props.name: uncheckedValue
props.description: The value submitted with the form when the switch is off. By default, unchecked switches do not submit any value, matching native checkbox behavior.

props.name: value
props.description: The value submitted with the form when the switch is on. By default, switch submits the "on" value, matching native checkbox behavior.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
